name: Local Read-only Inspector
description: A local read-only inspector that lists a caller-selected folder without modifying its files.
readme:
# Local Read-only Inspector

## Install
Run the inspected package in a restricted test environment.

```bash
npm install @example/local-inspector
```

## Tools and inputs
The list_files tool takes a folder argument. Only explicitly permitted folders can be read.

## Outputs
Returns a JSON array of file names; an empty folder returns an empty array.

## Security and limitations
The tool does not write files or access the network. Only use a test folder with no secrets. These are example documentation claims, not runtime-verified guarantees.

## Errors
An inaccessible folder returns an access-denied error; do not retry without verifying permissions.
